group_headway_secs.scope: Route and direction, shared among patterns
group_headway_secs.reason: A uniform reference service of four departures per hour; not an observed or calibrated frequency.
group_headway_secs.override: group_headway_secs for shared service; headway_secs or services.headway_secs per pattern

start_time.reason: A fixed daytime reference window, independent of the execution date; not an inferred opening time.

end_time.scope: Exclusive departure-window end at the first stop
end_time.reason: Completes a 16-hour reference window; arrivals farther along the route may be later.

dwell_time_secs.reason: Default speeds include stopping effects; zero additional dwell avoids counting these effects twice.

exact_times.reason: Represents a frequency rather than claiming exact departure times.

service_date.scope: Start of the synthetic reference week
service_date.reason: A fixed Saturday-to-Friday coordinate for weekdays; not a reconstruction of January 2026.
service_date.override: service_date for one day, or calendar/calendar_dates

service_days.scope: Only when no date or calendar is supplied
service_days.reason: Includes every weekday once so source weekday restrictions can be evaluated.

weekday_policy.value: Same conditions on every unspecified weekday
weekday_policy.scope: Days without source or explicit restrictions
weekday_policy.reason: Does not invent different weekday and weekend demand patterns.

distance_method.reason: Uses supplied distance, cumulative-distance difference, usable directed shape, then geodesic distance. Geodesic distance is a spatial proxy, not a recovered route.

agency_name.reason: Identifies a synthetic feed without inventing an operator.

agency_url.reason: Links to the generating project rather than inventing an operator website.

agency_timezone.scope: Only if source metadata and geographical lookup are inconclusive
agency_timezone.reason: A warned placeholder; geographical timezone inference does not establish an operator's actual timezone.

use_source_tags.reason: Uses interpretable route information before imposing model assumptions.

endpoint.reason: A configurable public Overpass endpoint, not an operating assumption.

timeout.reason: Bounds retrieval time; does not affect the service model.

overwrite_source.reason: Protects retrieved fields and stopping sequences from accidental replacement.

include_provenance.reason: Retains the effective assumptions next to the GTFS archive.

provenance_path.reason: Restores adjacent provenance when present; missing history is not invented.
provenance_path.override: Explicit path, or None to disable

overwrite.reason: Protects existing archives and provenance files.

speed_reason: The existing mode-specific compatibility baseline is retained provisionally. It is not a measured, calibrated or globally validated speed; stopping effects are included by assumption.
variation: Constant speed and headway within each resolved period; no random or inferred peak adjustment
duration_allocation: Subtract known leg times and intermediate dwell from the route duration, then allocate the positive remainder in proportion to missing-leg distances.
group_allocation: Divide the reference departure rate equally among the selected patterns in a route-direction group; preserve explicit and source intervals. An unresolved OSM parent direction uses one shared group.
